products.title: M.A.C Prep + Prime Fix+ Mattifying Mist 100ml
products.body_html:
M.A.C Prep + Prime Fix+ Mattifying Mist 100ml is a lightweight setting spray designed to refresh the complexion while helping to keep unwanted shine under control. The ultra-fine mist is infused with vitamins, minerals and a soothing blend of green tea, chamomile and cucumber to leave skin feeling comforted and lightly hydrated. Silica and oil-absorbing powders work to rebalance the look of the skin, helping to reduce the appearance of pores and support a smoother, more matte finish without disturbing make-up.

Ideal for all skin types, especially combination or oily skin, this versatile mist fits easily into any make-up routine. Use it on bare skin as a priming step before foundation, or spritz over finished make-up to help extend wear for up to 12 hours and keep the complexion looking fresh throughout the day. The fine spray feels cooling on the skin and is easy to top up whenever shine appears, making it a useful companion for long days, evenings out or on-the-go touch-ups.

Why we love it
['- Helps to control shine and oil while supporting a smoother, more matte-looking complexion for up to 12 hours of wear.', '- Infused with green tea, chamomile, cucumber and vitamins to leave skin feeling soothed, lightly hydrated and refreshed.', '- Versatile formula that works as both a priming mist on bare skin and a setting spray over make-up, ideal for busy days and evenings out.', '- Fine, weightless mist is suitable for all skin types, including non-comedogenic, dermatologist- and ophthalmologist-tested skin.']

How to use
How to Use:
Shake the bottle very well before each use to disperse the mattifying powders. With eyes and mouth completely closed, hold the bottle around 10–12 inches from the face and mist evenly over the skin. Use on clean skin before make-up as a priming step, and/or over finished make-up to help set and refresh. Reapply during the day whenever shine appears or make-up needs a quick reset.

Frequency:
Use as needed throughout the day, following the product instructions.

Application Technique:
Hold the bottle at arm’s length and press the pump firmly for a fine, even mist. Allow the spray to settle and dry naturally on the skin without rubbing or patting. Layer lightly rather than saturating the face, building up if extra shine control is desired.

Best Practices:
Apply to clean, dry skin as part of the final step in your skincare routine and before or after make-up. Avoid spraying too close to the face to prevent wet spots. Allow base products such as foundation and concealer to set before misting over them.

Safety Tips:
For external use only. Avoid direct contact with eyes and mouth; if contact occurs, rinse well with water. Discontinue use if irritation occurs and keep out of reach of children. Always follow any additional guidance on the product packaging.

products.title: M.A.C Strobe Beam Liquid Blush
products.body_html:
M·A·C Strobe Beam Liquid Blush in Apricot Jelly is an iridescent liquid blush designed to bring a fresh, luminous flush to the cheeks. The sheer, water-based formula feels lightweight on the skin and can be built up from a soft tint to a more vivid pop of colour, making it easy to tailor the look from day to night. Inspired by sunrise and sunset tones, Apricot Jelly offers a bright orange hue with golden pearlescent particles that helps to promote the look of healthy, radiant-looking skin while adding a touch of warmth to the complexion.

This product fits seamlessly into a make-up routine wherever a natural-looking glow is desired. It can be used alone on bare skin for a quick, dewy finish or layered with foundation and other complexion products to sculpt, shape and subtly highlight the cheeks. The conditioning blend in the formula is designed to feel comfortable throughout the day, while the blendable texture works to leave the skin looking smooth, fresh and softly lit.

Why we love it
- Sheer, water-based liquid blush that builds easily from a soft tint to a more vivid flush
- Iridescent finish with bright apricot colour and golden pearlescent particles that helps to promote a fresh, radiant-looking complexion
- Lightweight, conditioning formula designed to feel comfortable on the skin throughout the day
- Versatile texture that can be worn alone, layered over or under foundation, or mixed with base products for customised glow and dimension

How to use
How to Use:
Apply to clean, prepared skin. Dot a small amount of Strobe Beam Liquid Blush Apricot Jelly directly onto the cheeks. Blend out with fingertips or a suitable brush, building the colour gradually to your desired intensity. Layer over or under foundation as preferred, or mix a small amount into foundation for a soft, glowing finish.

Frequency:
Use as needed.

Application Technique:
Apply one to two small dots to each cheek, then gently tap and blend into the skin using fingers or a brush, working upwards and outwards. Add extra dots for a stronger look, and allow each layer to settle before adding more. The formula can be used over both liquid and powder make-up.

Best Practices:
Apply to well-moisturised skin and blend quickly to avoid visible edges. Start with a light layer and build slowly. Allow base products to set slightly before applying, and finish with setting powder if longer wear is desired.

Safety Tips:
For external use only. Avoid direct contact with the eyes. Discontinue use if irritation occurs and keep out of reach of children. Follow any additional guidance on the product packaging.

products.title: M.A.C Moisturizers Mineralize Timecheck Lotion 30ml
products.body_html:
M.A.C Mineralize Timecheck Lotion is a lightweight, gel-like moisturiser designed to smooth the look of skin while adding comfortable hydration. The formula works to soften the appearance of fine lines, wrinkles and visible pores, helping the complexion appear more refined and even. Infused with M.A.C’s Charged Water technology, shea butter, mango seed butter and hyaluronic acid, it helps to replenish moisture and support a plumper, more supple feel. Optical blurring polymers lend a soft-focus finish that prepares the skin beautifully for make-up.

Suitable for all skin types, including sensitive, this lotion fits easily into a daily skincare and make-up routine. It can be used in the morning to create a smoother canvas for foundation and in the evening for a comforting layer of hydration. With regular use, the skin is left feeling softer and better cushioned, while radiance is enhanced for a fresher, more rested-looking complexion.

Why we love it
- Gel-like texture that feels cooling on application and helps skin look instantly smoother
- Optical blurring polymers help soften the look of pores, fine lines and wrinkles for a soft-focus finish
- Charged Water technology, shea butter and hyaluronic acid work to hydrate and support a plumper, more supple feel
- Doubles as a moisturiser and make-up base, creating a refined canvas that helps foundation apply more evenly on all skin types

How to use
How to Use:
Apply to freshly cleansed skin. Dispense a small amount of the lotion and gently massage over the face and neck using clean fingertips. Allow the formula to absorb before applying make-up or additional skincare.

Frequency:
Use as needed, following the product instructions.

Application Technique:
Work the lotion over the skin in upward, outward motions, focusing on areas where pores and fine lines are most visible. Leave on the skin; do not rinse. Layer make-up on top once the product has settled.

Best Practices:
Apply to clean, dry skin as the moisturising step in a routine, morning and/or evening. Allow a few moments for the texture to settle before applying primer or foundation. Follow with daytime sun protection if using in the morning.

Safety Tips:
For external use only. Avoid direct contact with the eyes; if contact occurs, rinse well with water. Discontinue use if irritation occurs and keep out of reach of children. Always follow any additional guidance on the product packaging.

products.title: M.A.C Studio Fix Mattifine 12HR Shine-Control Primer 30ml
products.body_html:
M·A·C Studio Fix Mattifine 12HR Shine-Control Primer is a mattifying make-up base designed to support a smoother-looking, longer-wearing complexion. The lightweight gel-to-powder texture glides over the skin, helping to diffuse the look of visible pores while immediately reducing the appearance of excess shine. Formulated to be oil-free, sweat- and humidity-resistant, it works to keep foundation looking fresher for up to 12 hours and may help skin feel more refined for hours after application.

Infused with shine-controlling Oil-Check Complex, lactobionic acid (PHA), algae extract and witch hazel, this primer is particularly suited to combination and oily skin types, or anyone who finds make-up breaks down through the day. Used after moisturiser and before foundation, it helps create a velvety, powder-soft finish that still feels weightless and comfortable on the skin. Worn alone, it can be used to help keep the T-zone looking more balanced and to promote a smoother, more even-looking canvas.

Why we love it
- Helps to keep shine under control for up to 12 hours while supporting a smoother-looking complexion
- Lightweight gel-to-powder texture leaves skin with a velvety, matte finish that still feels comfortable
- Oil-free, sweat- and humidity-resistant formula is well suited to oily and combination skin types
- Works seamlessly under foundation or worn alone to help minimise the look of pores and extend make-up wear

How to use
How to Use:
Apply to clean, dry skin after your usual moisturiser. Smooth a small, pea-sized amount of Studio Fix Mattifine 12HR Shine-Control Primer over the face, focusing on areas prone to oiliness or visible pores. Allow the formula to settle briefly, then follow with foundation or wear alone for a softly mattified finish.

Frequency:
Use as needed as part of your make-up routine, according to the product instructions.

Application Technique:
Dispense a small amount onto fingertips, a sponge or a brush. Gently smooth and blend over the T-zone and any other areas where shine tends to appear, then sweep over the rest of the face for an even base. Do not rinse; apply make-up directly over the primer once it has set.

Best Practices:
For best results, apply to thoroughly cleansed, well-moisturised skin and use thin, even layers rather than a thick coat. Allow skincare to absorb fully before applying the primer, and give the primer a moment to settle before foundation. Pair with long-wear foundation for extended make-up longevity.

Safety Tips:
For external use only. Avoid direct contact with the eyes. If irritation occurs, discontinue use and consult the product packaging for further guidance. Keep out of reach of children and store according to the instructions on the pack.

products.title: M.A.C Glow Play Blush
products.body_html:
M·A·C Glow Play Blush in Groovy is a cushiony, cream-to-powder blush designed to give cheeks a fresh, radiant flush. The bouncy formula offers sheer-to-medium, buildable colour with a silky feel that seems to melt into the skin rather than sit on top. Infused with jojoba and grape seed oils plus vitamin E, it helps to condition the skin and encourages a smoother-looking finish, while soft-focus pigments work to blur the look of pores and fine lines for a natural, healthy-looking glow.

Ideal for all skin types, this versatile blush can be used to brighten the complexion every day or dialled up for a more vivid pop of colour. The Groovy shade is a bright, uplifting coral-pink that adds instant warmth and liveliness to the face. The fingertip-friendly texture makes on-the-go application easy, whether you prefer to tap it onto bare skin or layer over foundation. Use it as the final touch in your make-up routine to bring life and dimension back to the cheeks.

Why we love it
- Bouncy, cushiony cream-to-powder texture that blends effortlessly and feels lightweight on the skin
- Buildable sheer-to-medium colour that helps to create anything from a soft flush to a more vivid pop on the cheeks
- Enriched with jojoba and grape seed oils plus vitamin E to help condition skin and promote a smoother-looking finish
- Fingertip-friendly formula that works well on all skin types and fits easily into an everyday make-up routine

How to use
How to Use:
Start with clean, prepared skin and apply your base make-up if desired. Using fingertips, pick up a small amount of M·A·C Glow Play Blush in Groovy and tap onto the apples of the cheeks. Blend upwards and outwards towards the temples. Build in light layers until you reach your desired level of colour.

Frequency:
Use as needed as part of your daily make-up routine or whenever you’d like to add a flush of colour.

Application Technique:
Apply with fingertips for a quick, seamless finish, or use a blush brush such as a duo-fibre or stippling brush to diffuse the colour. The formula can be used on bare skin or layered over foundation and setting powder, gently pressing rather than dragging to maintain a smooth base.

Best Practices:
Apply in thin layers to maintain control over intensity. Allow your base products to set before adding blush, and blend edges well for a soft-focus effect. Close the compact securely after use to help protect the texture.

Safety Tips:
For external use only. Avoid direct contact with the eyes. If irritation occurs, discontinue use and consult a professional. Keep out of reach of children and follow any additional guidance on the packaging.

products.title: M.A.C Squirt Plumping Gloss Stick
products.body_html:
M·A·C Squirt Plumping Gloss Stick in Hazard is a playful take on lip colour, offering a sheer yellow‑orange tint with a high‑shine, non‑sticky finish. The balm‑like stick glides smoothly over the lips, melting on contact to deliver a juicy, glassy look that still feels lightweight and comfortable. Enriched with coconut oil, shea butter and avocado oil, the formula is designed to nourish and condition, helping lips feel softer and more supple with every swipe.

Ideal for anyone who enjoys a subtle wash of colour with a modern, glossy finish, this gloss stick fits easily into everyday make‑up routines. It can be worn alone for a fresh, translucent tint or layered over lipstick to add shine and dimension. Plumping ingredients, including ginger root oil, capsicum extract and menthol crystals, create a gentle tingling sensation that helps to promote the look of fuller lips, leaving them looking smooth, hydrated and beautifully luminous.

Why we love it
- Delivers a sheer yellow‑orange tint with a glassy, high‑shine finish that still feels lightweight and non‑sticky.
- Enriched with coconut oil, shea butter and avocado oil to help nourish, soften and condition the lips.
- Plumping complex with ginger root oil, capsicum extract and menthol crystals provides a gentle tingle and helps promote the look of fuller lips.
- Easy‑to‑use stick format that’s ideal for on‑the‑go touch‑ups, worn alone or layered over lip liner or lipstick for added dimension.

How to use
How to Use:
Apply to clean, dry lips. Twist the non‑retractable stick until you hear one to two clicks to release a small amount of product, then smooth directly over the lips. Reapply as desired throughout the day, or layer over lipstick for added shine and a plumped‑up finish.

Frequency:
Use as needed throughout the day, according to the product instructions.

Application Technique:
Glide the stick evenly across the top and bottom lips, following the natural lip line. Press lips together to distribute the gloss and build up thin layers until the desired level of shine and colour is achieved.

Best Practices:
Apply to bare lips for a sheer, translucent tint or over lip liner or lipstick to enhance colour and definition. Start with a small amount to avoid over‑twisting the non‑retractable stick. For a more defined look, outline lips with a lip pencil before applying the gloss stick.

Safety Tips:
For external use only. Avoid contact with the eyes. You may experience a tingling sensation; if irritation or discomfort occurs, discontinue use. Keep out of reach of children and follow any additional guidance on the packaging.

- Buildable colour payoff, allowing a soft daytime wash or a more defined, smoky eye
- Works easily alongside other shades, making it a versatile addition to any eye make-up routine
- Compact 1.5g size that’s ideal for everyday use and convenient for travel or touch-ups

How to use
How to Use:
Start with clean, dry eyelids. Using an eye shadow brush or clean fingertip, pick up a small amount of M.A.C Eye Shadow Club Satin 1.5g and gently press or sweep onto the lid. Build the colour gradually, adding more where extra depth is desired. Blend the edges so the colour diffuses smoothly into the crease or other shades.

Frequency:
Use as needed, according to the look you’d like to create.

Application Technique:
Apply directly to the eyelid, focusing colour near the lash line and blending upwards for a softer finish. For more intensity, layer additional product or pair with deeper or lighter tones to contour and highlight the eye area.

Best Practices:
Apply over dry skin or an eye primer to help the colour appear smoother and last longer. Use clean tools for application and blend in thin layers rather than applying too much at once.

Safety Tips:
For external use only. Avoid getting product directly into the eyes. If irritation occurs, discontinue use and consult the product packaging for further guidance. Keep out of reach of children.

products.title: M.A.C Mascara Extended Play Gigablack Lash Mascara 5.7g
products.body_html:
M·A·C Extended Play Gigablack Lash Mascara is a lightweight tubing mascara designed to give lashes clean, defined length with a deep black finish. The carbon-black formula wraps each lash in flexible polymers to help enhance lift and separation while resisting smudging, flaking, sweat and humidity for up to 16 hours of comfortable wear. The slim, precise brush is created to reach even the tiniest lashes, making it especially useful for shorter lashes and for defining the lower lash line without clumps. The result is lashes that look longer, more defined and beautifully framed, yet still natural enough for everyday wear.

This mascara fits easily into a daily make-up routine, whether used alone for subtle definition or layered with other eye products for a more striking look. It removes with warm water and gentle pressure, so there’s no need for heavy rubbing at the end of the day. Suitable for contact lens wearers and those with sensitive eyes, it offers a reliable option when long-lasting, smudge-resistant definition is desired.

Why we love it
- Lightweight tubing formula helps to lengthen and define lashes while feeling comfortable all day.
- Smudge-proof, flake-resistant wear for up to 16 hours, yet removes easily with warm water.
- Slim, precise brush is designed to catch even the tiniest lashes, ideal for detail on top and bottom lashes.
- Ophthalmologist tested and suitable for contact lens wearers and sensitive eyes, making it a dependable everyday choice.

How to use
How to Use:
Start with clean, dry lashes. Press the M·A·C Extended Play Gigablack Lash Mascara brush into the base of the lashes. Gently shimmy and pull the brush from roots to tips to coat each lash. Repeat to build extra length and definition, focusing the slim brush on the outer corners and lower lashes if desired. Remove with warm water and gentle pressure.

Frequency:
Use as needed, according to the product instructions and your usual make-up routine.

Application Technique:
Apply in thin, even coats, allowing a moment between layers if building intensity. Use the tip of the brush to catch shorter or hard‑to‑reach lashes. Avoid pumping the wand in the tube to help maintain the formula.

Best Practices:
Apply after completing eye shadow and liner to keep lashes clean. Ensure lashes are dry between coats to help minimise clumping. If using an eyelash curler, curl lashes before applying mascara. Close the cap tightly after use to help prevent the formula from drying out.

Safety Tips:
For external use only. Avoid direct contact with the eyes. If irritation occurs, discontinue use and seek advice if needed. Keep out of reach of children and follow any additional guidance on the packaging.

products.title: M.A.C Mascara M.A.CStack Mega Brush Chestnut Stack 12ml
products.body_html:
M·A·CStack Mega Brush Chestnut Stack Mascara is a volumising, lengthening formula designed for those who like to build their lash look from subtle definition to bold impact. The rich chestnut brown shade offers a softer alternative to classic black, flattering a wide range of eye colours and ideal for everyday wear or a more understated evening look. The clump‑resistant texture works to separate and coat each lash, helping lashes appear longer, fuller and more lifted while still feeling lightweight and comfortable throughout the day.

This mascara is designed to be layered, so you can customise the effect to suit your mood, from a single coat for natural enhancement to multiple coats for more dramatic volume. The Mega Brush is tailored for upper and longer lashes, helping to fan them out and catch each lash from root to tip. Use it as the finishing step in your eye make‑up routine after eyeshadow and liner to frame the eyes and complete your look.

Why we love it
- Buildable, clump‑resistant formula that helps lashes look fuller and longer without feeling heavy
- Chestnut brown shade offers a softer, flattering alternative to black for everyday or understated looks
- Mega Brush is designed to catch and coat each lash from root to tip for lifted, fanned‑out definition
- Works seamlessly from a single natural coat to multiple layers for more dramatic volume, fitting easily into any eye make‑up routine

How to use
How to Use:
Start with clean, dry lashes and remove any excess oil or residue. Wipe any excess product from the wand. Holding the Mega Brush horizontally, press it into the base of the upper lashes and sweep through to the tips, wiggling slightly to coat each lash. Apply additional coats while the formula is still slightly damp, building volume and length until you reach your desired look.

Frequency:
Use as needed, according to the product instructions and your make‑up routine.

Application Technique:
Focus the brush at the roots to help create lift, then pull through to the ends for length and separation. Use the tip of the brush to reach corner lashes and any shorter lashes that need extra definition.

Best Practices:
Apply after completing eye shadow and liner. Allow each coat to set briefly before adding more. Remove mascara thoroughly at the end of the day with an appropriate eye make‑up remover to help keep lashes in good condition.

Safety Tips:
Avoid getting the product directly into the eyes. If irritation occurs, discontinue use. Use externally only and keep out of reach of children. Follow any additional guidance on the packaging.

products.title: M.A.C Eye Kohl
products.body_html:
M·A·C Eye Kohl Costa Riche is a classic kohl pencil designed to define and enhance the eyes with rich, warm colour. The soft, smooth texture glides along the lash line and waterline without dragging, making it comfortable for everyday use as well as more dramatic looks. The formula delivers intense pigment with a silky matte/pearl finish, so it can be worn as a precise line or blended out for a softer, smoky effect. Ophthalmologist testing and suitability for contact lens wearers help to make this a reassuring choice for sensitive eyes.

This versatile pencil fits easily into any make-up routine. Use it to add subtle definition for daytime, to deepen the lash line for evening, or to create a smudged, lived‑in eye look. The Costa Riche shade offers a deep, earthy brown tone that flatters a wide range of eye colours and skin tones, bringing warmth and depth to the eyes. Sharpen as needed to keep the tip precise for detailed work or softly smudged styles.

Why we love it
- Soft, blendable kohl texture that glides on smoothly without tugging at the delicate eye area
- Rich Costa Riche shade offers warm, deep brown colour that helps to enhance and define the eyes
- Versatile formula that can be worn as a precise line or smudged out for an effortless smoky look
- Ophthalmologist-tested and suitable for contact lens wearers, making it a considered choice for everyday eye make-up

How to use
How to Use:
Ensure the eye area is clean and dry. Apply M·A·C Eye Kohl Costa Riche directly along the upper lash line, starting from the inner corner and working outwards. Line the lower lash line or waterline if desired, using light strokes for control. For a softer or smoky effect, gently smudge the line with a brush or fingertip before it sets.

Frequency:
Use as needed, according to the look you’d like to create and the product instructions.

Application Technique:
Hold the pencil close to the tip for better precision. Use short, feathered strokes rather than one continuous line, especially along the waterline. Sharpen the pencil regularly to maintain a fine point for detailed work, or use a slightly blunter tip for a diffused finish.

Best Practices:
Apply after eyeshadow or before mascara, depending on your preferred routine. Avoid pressing too hard on the delicate eye area. Replace the cap firmly after use to help protect the formula.

Safety Tips:
For external use only. Avoid direct contact with the inner eye. If irritation occurs, discontinue use and seek advice if needed. Keep out of reach of children and follow any additional guidance on the packaging.

products.title: M.A.C Mineralize Skinfinish Natural
products.body_html:
M·A·C Mineralize Skinfinish Natural Light is a domed, baked face powder designed to give skin a softly polished, natural-looking finish. The lightweight formula offers sheer coverage that helps to even the look of skin tone, gently diffuse the appearance of imperfections and reduce unwanted shine without masking the skin. Infused with a multi-mineral complex and low-level pearlised pigments, it works to promote a smoother, more dimensional complexion that still looks like skin, making it a versatile choice for everyday wear.

This shade, Light, is ideal for fair to light complexions and can be used in several ways within a routine. Sweep it over bare, moisturised skin for a quick, minimal make-up day, or apply over liquid or cream foundation to set make-up and extend its wear. The silky texture layers comfortably, so it can also be used to refresh make-up throughout the day without feeling heavy or cakey, leaving the complexion looking softly matte and comfortably balanced.

Why we love it
- Sheer, buildable coverage helps to even the look of skin tone while still letting natural skin show through.
- Slow-baked, mineral-rich formula with low-level pearlised pigments promotes a soft, dimensional, natural-matte finish.
- Versatile powder that can be worn alone, used to set foundation, or applied for quick touch-ups during the day.
- Lightweight texture feels comfortable on the skin and is suitable for everyday use across a wide range of skin types.

How to use
How to Use:
Start with clean, well-moisturised skin and apply your usual base make-up if desired. Using a large, fluffy powder brush, pick up a small amount of M·A·C Mineralize Skinfinish Natural Light and tap off any excess. Sweep the powder over the face, focusing on the centre and any areas that tend to shine. Build up light layers where a little more coverage or setting is needed, and use for touch-ups during the day as required.

Frequency:
Use as needed to set make-up or refresh shine throughout the day, according to the product instructions.

Application Technique:
Apply with a soft powder brush in light, sweeping motions, starting from the centre of the face and blending outwards. Use a lighter hand around the eye area and along the edges of the face for a seamless, natural-looking finish.

Best Practices:
Apply over well-blended foundation or directly onto moisturised skin. Use thin layers rather than one heavy application to help maintain a natural look. Allow any liquid or cream products to settle before applying powder, and choose a clean brush for the smoothest result.

Safety Tips:
For external use only. Avoid getting the product into the eyes. If irritation occurs, discontinue use and consult the product packaging for further guidance. Keep out of reach of children and store the compact closed when not in use.

products.body_html:
M·A·CStack Mascara Mega Brush 12ml is a volumising mascara designed to let you build your lash look exactly as you like it, from subtle definition to bold, dramatic volume. The lightweight, liquid formula works to lengthen and thicken the appearance of each lash while resisting clumping, flaking and smudging. The bespoke Mega Brush is created for upper and longer lashes, coating them from root to tip with rich black pigment for a fuller, lifted effect that still feels comfortable throughout the day.

Ideal for anyone who enjoys tailoring their mascara to different occasions, this product fits easily into both everyday and evening make-up routines. It’s suitable for all skin tones and eye colours, and may be especially appealing if you prefer a buildable finish rather than a single heavy coat. Use it after curling the lashes or as the final step in an eye look to help frame the eyes and enhance definition, while enjoying up to 24 hours of weightless wear.

Why we love it
- Buildable formula that helps you customise your lash look from soft definition to striking volume without heavy feel
- Mega Brush designed to coat longer and upper lashes from root to tip for an instantly lifted, lengthened effect
- Long-wearing, clump-resistant texture that resists flaking and smudging for up to 24 hours
- Suitable for a wide range of looks and occasions, making it an easy everyday staple or evening go-to in any make-up bag

How to use
How to Use:
Start with clean, dry lashes. Press the M·A·CStack Mascara Mega Brush into the lashes as close to the roots as possible, then wiggle and sweep the brush through to the tips. Repeat to build additional layers until you reach your desired volume and length.

Frequency:
Use as needed as part of your daily or occasional make-up routine, according to the product instructions.

Application Technique:
Work from root to tip using a gentle shimmying motion to help separate and coat each lash evenly. Focus the Mega Brush on upper and longer lashes for maximum impact, and use the tip of the brush to reach corner lashes.

Best Practices:
Apply after completing eye make-up to avoid smudging. Allow each light layer to set briefly before adding more for extra volume. Remove mascara thoroughly at the end of the day with an appropriate eye make-up remover.

Safety Tips:

products.title: M.A.C Fix+ Multitasking Setting Spray 100ml
products.body_html:
M·A·C Fix+ Multitasking Setting Spray 100ml is a lightweight, alcohol-free mist designed to bring make-up and skin together beautifully. The fine spray helps to hydrate the complexion, soften any powdery finish and encourage a more seamless, natural-looking result. Infused with vitamins, minerals and soothing extracts of green tea, chamomile and cucumber, it works to leave skin feeling refreshed and comfortable while adding a subtle, hydrated glow.

Ideal for all skin types, this versatile spray can be used before, during or after make-up. Use it on bare skin to prep and lightly hydrate, between complexion steps to help base products meld together, or as the final step in your routine to help keep make-up looking fresh for up to 12 hours. It can also be misted onto brushes to intensify powders and pigments, making it a useful addition to both everyday routines and more polished looks.

Why we love it
- Hydrating, alcohol-free mist that helps make-up sit more comfortably on the skin while promoting a fresh, natural-looking finish.
- Multitasking formula that can prime, set and refresh, fitting easily into both simple and more detailed make-up routines.
- Enriched with vitamins, minerals and soothing green tea, chamomile and cucumber extracts to leave skin feeling cooled and comforted.
- Fine spray can be used on skin or brushes to help powders and pigments apply more smoothly and with enhanced intensity.

How to use
How to Use:
Start with clean, finished make-up or bare skin. Hold the bottle around 12 inches from the face and close eyes and mouth. Mist the skin in an even X and T motion before, during or after make-up application, allowing a few moments for the fine mist to settle.

Frequency:
Use as needed throughout the day or according to the product instructions.

Application Technique:
Apply to the entire face, keeping the nozzle at arm’s length for a light, even veil. For more intensity from powder products, lightly mist a brush with the spray before picking up eyeshadow or pigment, then apply as usual.

Best Practices:
Use on top of make-up to help reduce a powdery look and encourage a more blended finish. Allow the mist to dry naturally rather than rubbing. Store the bottle upright and ensure the cap is secured when not in use.

Safety Tips:
For external use only. Avoid direct contact with eyes; if contact occurs, rinse with water. Discontinue use if irritation occurs and keep out of reach of children.
